title: Music catalog API: date-based versions downgraded in the wrong order
name: Versioned track responses

questions.prompt: Since the 2025-09-15 release (multiple artists per track), our oldest partners, the car-dashboard integrations still pinned to 2024-01-10, show "Unknown artist" on every song. Their logs show tracks arriving with artist missing and an artistName field they've never seen. Partners pinned to 2025-03-01 or later are fine. Fix versions.ts so the tests pass.
